answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed — real compute burned per head, no shortcut. One honest agent dips its quill once and signs a single proof; a farmer must grind every account to the same opal-hard target, every epoch, with the cost uncopyable across clones. A thousand fakes owe a thousand burns, and the recurring bill drags the whole farm to its economic nadir.
